fields.Name: IT100 - RunQuery Rendering over GraphQL
fields.Description: Client-transport slice of the query rendering matrix; needs a running MJAPI. Creates a query category and saved queries over GraphQL that read a literal derived table (valid unchanged on SQL Server and PostgreSQL), then runs a saved query and a composed query through every MaxRows / StartRow combination of the matrix over the wire, and TestQuerySQL with MaxRows. Every call asserts returned rows and TotalRowCount. On PostgreSQL, twelve concurrent runs of a saved query read statement_timeout and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout from MJAPI's pooled backends and must see the values derived from the default requestTimeout (30s and 1min). With a read-only login configured (DB_READ_ONLY_USERNAME / DB_READ_ONLY_PASSWORD on the server, and DB_READ_ONLY_USERNAME for the runner), it also checks that TestQuerySQL runs as that login and, on PostgreSQL, that a session setting changed through TestQuerySQL is not seen by the following twenty requests; without one those checks report a skip. Fixtures are removed in teardown.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Saved and composed queries return exactly the expected rows and totals on every MaxRows / StartRow combination over GraphQL; TestQuerySQL honours MaxRows; PostgreSQL backends carry the statement and idle-in-transaction timeouts; TestQuerySQL runs as the read-only login and leaves no session state; fixtures cleaned up.
